This topic is now closed because the question was posted twice. The similar discussion titled 'socket x50' is available within the [product_name] - Hardware section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user received a [product_name], but the package was missing the required card adapter for slot x50 despite being sealed. The absence of this part prevents key functionality, and the user is unable to locate the adapter or its identification code online.
